notes: RC125: a version of the 3D depth model built for the headset's NPU (same depth, 99.6% match in testing). About 30 seconds after you open the app, the NPU test runs by itself: it checks the NPU is faster AND gives the same depth as before. Only if both are true does 3D switch to the NPU, automatically. Keep the app open ~3 minutes, then send a report. Quest validation required.
